    def test_context_retention(sheet_name, test_name, prompt, section_name, entry_name, evaluation_metrice, evaluation_model, client, ragmetric, generate):
        """
        Test context retention for 3 randomly picked rows from the Excel sheet.
        """
        import ast
        import uuid
        import io, sys, datetime
        from tests.helpers import TestViewHelpers
    
        allure.dynamic.parent_suite(sheet_name)
        allure.dynamic.suite("context_retention")
        allure.dynamic.sub_suite(test_name)
        exec_time = datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()
        allure.attach(exec_time, name="Execution Time", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
        stdout_capture = io.StringIO()
        old_stdout = sys.stdout
        sys.stdout = stdout_capture
        try:
            # Generate a single view prompt dynamically using section and item descriptions from Excel sheets
            try:
                sections_data = load_sections()
            except Exception:
                sections_data = []
            section_desc = None
            for s in sections_data:
                if s.get('SECTION_NAME') == section_name:
                    section_desc = s.get('SECTION_DESC')
                    break
    
            # Get item description from entries XLSX
            try:
                entries_data = load_entries()
            except Exception:
                entries_data = []
            item_desc = None
            for e in entries_data:
                if e.get('ENTRY_NAME') == entry_name:
                    item_desc = e.get('ITEM_DESC')
                    break
    
            prompt_to_use = generate.view_query(section_desc or "", item_desc or "", section_name, entry_name)
    
            # Use the same chat_id for all tests in the same sheet
            global _context_retention_chat_ids
            if sheet_name not in _context_retention_chat_ids:
                _context_retention_chat_ids[sheet_name] = client.create_chat()
            chat_id = _context_retention_chat_ids[sheet_name]
            allure.attach(chat_id, name="Chat ID", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
    
            # Initialize helper for metadata validation
            helpers = TestViewHelpers(client, generate, ragmetric, chat_id, section_name, entry_name, section_desc or "", item_desc or "")
    
            ask_result = client.ask(chat_id=chat_id, user_query=prompt_to_use)
            text_response = ask_result["text_response"]
            metadata = ask_result.get("metadata")
            latency = ask_result.get("latency")
            # expected_response = generate.expected_answer(section_name=section_name, entry_name=entry_name, query=prompt_to_use)
                # Conversation turns for Allure
            allure.attach(str(metadata), name="Metadata", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
            if metadata and metadata.get("type") in ["info"]:
                # Attach prompt and response before validation for visibility in allure
                allure.attach(str(prompt_to_use), name="Prompt", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                allure.attach(str(text_response), name="LLM Response", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                allure.attach(str(latency), name="Latency", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
    
                # Validate metadata section and entry names match sheet values
                helpers.validate_metadata_match(metadata)
    
                follow_up_prompt = generate.follow_up_update_query(query=prompt_to_use, llm_response=text_response, section_name=section_name, entry_name=entry_name, section_desc=section_desc or "", item_desc=item_desc or "")
    
                original_value = client.get_config_entry_with_mapped_section(section_name, entry_name, generate_llm=generate)
                allure.attach(str(original_value), name="Original Config Value", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                follow_up_ask_result = client.ask(chat_id=chat_id, user_query=follow_up_prompt)
                follow_up_text_response = follow_up_ask_result["text_response"]
    
                updated_value = client.get_config_entry_with_mapped_section(section_name, entry_name, generate_llm=generate)
                allure.attach(str(updated_value), name="Updated Config Value", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                # Evaluation: check if DB value matches intended update
                update_success = client.verify_update_with_prompt(updated_value, follow_up_prompt)
    
                # Restore original value
                restore_success = client.update_config_entry_value(original_value)
                allure.attach(str(restore_success), name="Restored DB value to original", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                # Conversation turns for Allure
                turns = [
                    {"role": "user", "content": prompt_to_use},
                    {"role": "assistant", "content": text_response},
                    {"role": "user", "content": follow_up_prompt},
                    {"role": "assistant", "content": follow_up_text_response}
                ]
                allure.attach(str(turns), name="Follow-up Conversation Turns", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                # Evaluation: LLM answer correctness for follow-up
                convo_test_case = ConversationalTestCase(turns=turns)
                conversational_professionalism_metric = ragmetric("context_retention")
                conversational_professionalism_metric.measure(convo_test_case)
                assert update_success, (
                    f"DB value does not match intended value after update.\nPrompt: {follow_up_prompt}\nDB Value: {updated_value}")
                allure.attach(str(conversational_professionalism_metric.score), name="Score", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                allure.attach(str(conversational_professionalism_metric.reason), name="Reason", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                assert conversational_professionalism_metric.is_successful(), f"Failed: {conversational_professionalism_metric.reason}"
                # assert metric.is_successful(), f"Follow-up LLM failed: {metric.reason}"
            elif metadata and metadata.get("type") == "error":
                allure.attach(str(metadata), name="Metadata", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
